name: grid-list
title: Grid list
description: A list to move through with arrow keys and select from: rows with a visual, a title and status (`layout="stack"`), or tiles in a responsive grid with actions and drag to reorder (`layout="grid"`).

when: Records read as one line each, and tables on narrow screens (`layout="stack"`).
Items people recognize by an image: photos, documents, cards (`layout="grid"`).

instead.when: People compare several fields across records.
A plain choice of options in a form, not records to open.

keyboard.does: Move between rows, or between tiles in two dimensions.
Opens the focused row or tile.

builtIn: Sections are named for screen readers.
Tile actions are always visible, so they need no hover and work on touch.
A drag handle gives the keyboard a way to reorder tiles.
youProvide: A name for each tile action that names the tile.
